unit: Daily report / Build Daily Digest open-action counting
description: The Actions tab holds at most one row per action_id, so the row-level open count and the distinct-action open count agree.
why_it_exists: The daily report was reporting numbers that did not reconcile. The census (2026-08-22) was written to find out whether that was an arithmetic bug in the digest or duplicate rows in the register, by computing actions_total_rows, distinct_action_ids, open_rows and distinct_open_action_ids side by side. If rows exceed distinct ids, the digest over-reports open work by exactly the duplicate count and no change to the digest can fix it.

expect.open_definition: an Actions row whose upper-cased status is not one of the done statuses

assertions: No action_id appears on more than one Actions row.
open_rows equals distinct_open_action_ids; a divergence is the size of the digest's over-count.
Every duplicate found must be reported with its sheet row number, status, matter_id and idempotency_key, because de-duplicating rows in a legal register is a human decision.
The status breakdown computed per row and the status breakdown computed per distinct action (taking the last row for each id) must be identical.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "invariant": not executed by harness/run.js.
